name: Big stories of God
description: Four weekly lessons for children's groups: God makes the world, keeps His promises, is with us when we're brave, and sends Jesus.

days.title: God made everything
days.note: Bring pictures or objects from nature. Read the creation story in short parts, asking children to show what God made each day.
days.devotional:
Teacher notes: Keep it simple and joyful. God made light, sky, land, plants, animals and people, and everything He made was good.

The big idea: God made everything, and He made you. Let children draw their favourite thing God made and thank Him for it.
days.prayer: Thank You, God, for making the world and for making me!
questions: What is your favourite thing God made?
How did God feel about what He made?
How can we look after God's world?

days.title: God keeps His promises
days.note: Tell the story of Noah with toy animals or pictures. Show a rainbow if you can.
days.devotional:
Teacher notes: Noah trusted God and built the boat even when it seemed strange. After the flood, God put a rainbow in the sky as a sign of His promise.

The big idea: God always keeps His promises. Ask children about a promise someone kept for them.
days.prayer: Dear God, thank You that You always keep Your promises.
questions: Why did Noah build the boat?
Can you think of a promise God makes to us?

days.title: God is with me when I'm brave
days.note: Act out David and Goliath: let a tall volunteer be Goliath and a small one be David.
days.devotional:
Teacher notes: Everyone was scared of Goliath. David was young, but he trusted that God was with him.

The big idea: we can be brave because God is with us. Ask children what makes them feel scared, and pray together for courage.
days.prayer: God, when I feel scared, help me remember You are with me.
questions: Why was everyone afraid of Goliath?
When do you need to be brave?

days.title: God sends Jesus
days.note: Tell the Christmas story with simple figures: Mary, Joseph, baby Jesus, shepherds and angels.
days.devotional:
Teacher notes: God's biggest promise came true when Jesus was born. The angels told shepherds the good news, and they hurried to see Him.

The big idea: Jesus came because God loves us. Let children share the good news with someone at home this week.
days.prayer: Thank You, God, for sending Jesus because You love us.
questions: Who were the first people to hear about Jesus?
Who can you tell about Jesus this week?
